purpose: Generate and independently validate the first and second perturbative directional coefficients L[V] and Q[V,V] of the memory-off analytic Einstein+AeST scalar-longitudinal 3+1 source system, with the nonanalytic Y sector explicitly excluded because it is handled by GE04/NL1B2.

frozen_action_structure.geometry: longitudinal plane-symmetric 3+1 coframe theta0=N dt, theta1=L(dx+b dt), theta2=R dy, theta3=R dz
frozen_action_structure.gravitational_kinetic: N L R^2[-4 kL kR-2 kR^2]
frozen_action_structure.excluded_from_GE06: -(2-K_B) J(Y), handled separately by Y2 and DY2

audit_parameters.note: Representative dimensionless values are used only for numerical generator conditioning; the functional Exp K(Q) form and exact coefficient identities are unchanged.

target_blocks.first_directional: L[V] = first epsilon derivative of every memory-off analytic Euler-Lagrange source
target_blocks.second_directional: Q[V,V] = second epsilon derivative of every memory-off analytic Euler-Lagrange source

deterministic_audit.first_order_direction: fixed multi-harmonic deterministic perturbations in N,L,R,b,u,phi

classification_rule.pass: all locked generator and finite-difference gates pass -> GE06_ANALYTIC_AEST_DIRECTIONAL_SOURCE_GENERATOR_PASS

claim_boundary: PASS certifies the memory-off analytic Einstein+AeST directional L/Q source generator in the controlled scalar-longitudinal plane-symmetric sector. It does not include the already separated Y operator, matter nonlinearities, solve Z20/Z21, introduce finite eta, or make observational/collapse claims.
anti_tuning: Do not change the action terms, representative audit parameters, background functions, deterministic direction, grid sizes, finite-difference steps or thresholds after inspecting GE06 output.
